references.qualities: Owner-rejected rail crossing the prayer icon row and cramped surrounding spacing.
Use the surrounding dashboard card gutters and Prayer challenge heading/control spacing as the product-specific reference for a calm, separated layout.

craft.evidence: The rail has its own uninterrupted row, with balanced card padding and cleanly separated caption.

coherence.evidence: Existing dark surfaces, typography, prayer identity colours and state styling remain coherent with the surrounding dashboard.

hierarchy.evidence: The current prayer and time remain the focal point; the rail and five prayer cards read as separate supporting rows.

stateMotion.evidence: Prayed, missed, current, next and upcoming remain distinct. The existing progress transition is unchanged; the maximum 18px marker is checked with transitions disabled.

actualSize.evidence: Independent reviewer inspected 320, 390, 768, 1440 and 2560px in-context renders. Narrow-phone status icons stack above their labels without clipping.

rejectionRegression.evidence: The rail no longer crosses prayer icons or times. Card gaps, interior padding, heading clearance and caption spacing directly address the owner screenshot.

rejectionsAddressed.evidence: Dedicated rail row above the cards; 24px desktop and 20px phone rail-to-card margins, increased card padding and 16px caption gap.
